summary: Dolby Laboratories filed a Form 8-K on August 27, 2026, announcing the appointment of Marc Whitten as President and CEO and board member, effective immediately. Whitten previously held roles at Meta, Cruise, Unity, Amazon, Sonos, and Microsoft. The filing discloses his employment agreement dated July 10, 2026, with compensation details, but does not mention a departure of a prior CEO—suggesting a planned succession. No advisor or board recommendation is noted. This is a forced or abrupt leadership change event. What to watch: potential strategic shifts under new leadership and any related proxy disclosures.
